method_policy: Reuse every MNIST pilot-selected parameter without retuning on Fashion-MNIST or evaluation seeds
condition_reason: The fixed mixture transfers the source comparison; label flip at the largest declared fraction tests direct training-data poisoning. Both are declared before inspecting any Fashion-MNIST run

statistics.bootstrap_unit: Complete seed, jointly across rules and both conditions
statistics.undefined_policy: Retain undefined values and counts; any missing required observation leaves its interval and paired comparison undefined
statistics.paired_tests: Two-sided exact conditional Wilcoxon over attacked condition-seed pairs, with a separate descriptive test on complete seed-level means
statistics.multiple_testing: One Holm family across both primary metrics and all three baseline contrasts; retain missing tests in the family size
statistics.interpretation: Three seeds give coarse, potentially unstable intervals. Conditions sharing seeds are dependent. Paired tests are descriptive and do not establish population-wide security or generalization to other datasets
